candidate.publicInterface: startRunnerSyncSession(request, snapshot, ports): RunnerSyncSessionDecision | renewRunnerSyncSession(session, clock, ports): RunnerSyncSessionDecision | recordRunnerSyncBuild(session, buildResult, ports): RunnerSyncSessionDecision | finalizeRunnerSyncPublication(session, currentHead, ports): RunnerSyncSessionDecision | reconcileRunnerSyncSession(session, observation, ports): RunnerSyncSessionDecision
candidate.rollback: The session module is pure and additive: it derives a durable RunnerSyncSessionState + coalesced group manifest + per-member child receipts from the caller-supplied snapshot and returns one next action. Rolling back means reverting the new module and the four adapters to the pre-0266 scattered path (steward-queue release + single-task receipt); no persisted runtime state schema changes are destructive because the durable state document is versioned (atm.runnerSyncSessionState.v1) and ignored by older readers.
causalValidators: coalesced-attribution: every released/reconciled member has an attributable child receipt referencing the shared group manifest
seal-continuity: a runner-affecting HEAD delta after seal forces ATM_RUNNER_SYNC_SEAL_REVALIDATION_REQUIRED; a non-runner-affecting delta does not
queue-durability: the group manifest is not removed before receipt-published; head-only receipt with missing member child receipts fails closed on release/non-head close
lease-heartbeat: a build lease expiring mid-build transitions to ATM_RUNNER_SYNC_STEWARD_LEASE_EXPIRED with a resume path, not silent request drop
crash-resume: a session persisted in building state resumes to receipt-published/released deterministically (ATM_RUNNER_SYNC_RESUME_REQUIRED)

seam.proposedInterface: startRunnerSyncSession(request, snapshot, ports): RunnerSyncSessionDecision | renewRunnerSyncSession(session, clock, ports): RunnerSyncSessionDecision | recordRunnerSyncBuild(session, buildResult, ports): RunnerSyncSessionDecision | finalizeRunnerSyncPublication(session, currentHead, ports): RunnerSyncSessionDecision | reconcileRunnerSyncSession(session, observation, ports): RunnerSyncSessionDecision
proposedAdapters: steward-queue-adapter: maps RunnerSyncStewardGroup (runner-sync-steward-queue.ts) member requests into the session group manifest and consumes finalize/reconcile decisions to drive releaseRunnerSyncStewardQueue

incremental-build-adapter: maps scripts/runner-sync-incremental-build.ts RunnerSyncReceipt + build observation into recordRunnerSyncBuild(buildResult) and emits per-member child receipts from the returned manifest
seam.deletionTest: If this module is deleted, the policy and caller complexity must reappear across callers; otherwise the module is too shallow.
seam.interfaceTest: Replace internals through the proposed interface and assert observable behavior through that interface only.

hiddenComplexity.leverage: Concentrate repeated policy behind one interface so callers gain more behavior per fact learned.
hiddenComplexity.locality: Keep fixes, rollback, and causal validator updates inside the owner atom or map.

replaceDontLayerTest: Replace old private-internal tests with tests through the proposed interface once the adapters exist; do not layer tests over old shallow modules.
